answer: Because the timing is logged against the reef challenge, the inlet audit can replay the vine history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 191 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 61 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
